# PRD Template

Write all PRDs in English. Use the structure below. Omit a section only if it is genuinely empty.

---

# {Feature Title}

## Overview
{1–3 sentences summarising the feature and its purpose.}

## Problem Statement
{What problem or opportunity does this feature address?}

## Goals
{Bullet list of measurable outcomes the feature should achieve.}

## Non-Goals
{What this feature explicitly does not cover.}

## Actors
{Who uses or is affected by this feature? Describe each role briefly.}

## User Journeys
{Step-by-step flows from the actor's perspective. One journey per primary path.}

## Functional Requirements
{Numbered list of functional behaviours the system must exhibit.}

## Business Rules
{Constraints, policies, and invariants that apply.}

## Edge Cases
{Unusual or boundary scenarios and how they should be handled.}

## Assumptions
{Facts taken as true without explicit confirmation.}

## Open Questions
{Unresolved items deferred by the user or still under discussion.}

## Success Signals
{Observable indicators that the feature is working as intended.}

## Scope Exclusions
{Explicitly out-of-scope items to prevent scope creep.}
